title: [review] provisioning.py:618: TOCTOU race in finally bl
description: In provision_node(), the finally block looks up session by peer_host (`self._sessions.get(peer_host)`) rather than holding a reference to the session created at entry. If a concurrent provision_node() call for the same peer_host replaces the session during the EDHOC handshake (while awaiting receive_message/send_message), the finally block retrieves and wipes the NEW session, breaking the concurrent provisioning attempt. The _remove_session() identity check (`is session`) does not protect here because the lookup returns the new session object.
close_reason: TOCTOU race already fixed. The finally block at line 662 uses self._remove_session(session, wipe=True) with the captured session reference from line 585, not a fresh lookup via self._sessions.get(peer_host). Security comments at lines 582-584 and 658-661 document the fix rationale. The _remove_session helper safely checks self._sessions[session.peer_host] is session before deletion.
